_note: Trouble and chance events. Choices and their prices are built in src/engine/rules.ts (eventChoices). Owner: P5.

loose_pipe.title: Loose water pipe
loose_pipe.line: A pipe drips. Air & water leaks until it is fixed.

pump_broken.title: Broken pump
pump_broken.line: The water pump stopped. Air & water leaks every sol.

hull_crack.title: Crack in the hull
hull_crack.line: A crack in module B. Air leaks out.

lamp_fault.title: Greenhouse lamps flicker
lamp_fault.line: The grow lamps are failing. Crops grow slower.

antenna_off.title: Antenna knocked off
antenna_off.line: The antenna points the wrong way. No radio.

power_fault.title: Blown fuse
power_fault.line: A fuse blew. Something must go dark today.

sick_crew.title: Someone feels ill
sick_crew.line: A crew member woke up ill.

solar_storm.title: Solar particle storm
solar_storm.line: Fast particles from the Sun. Everyone gets extra dose.

dust_storm.title: Dust storm
dust_storm.line: Dust hides the Sun. Fewer cells for some sols.

striped_rock.title: Striped rock outside
striped_rock.line: A rock with stripes sits near the airlock.

dawn_frost.title: Frost at dawn
dawn_frost.line: White frost on the ground. Gone by noon.

dust_devil.title: Dust devil
dust_devil.line: A whirlwind is crossing the plain.

blue_sunset.title: Blue sunset
blue_sunset.line: The sky is clear. Tonight the sunset will show.

clean_wind.title: Wind cleaned the panels
clean_wind.line: A gust blew the dust off the solar panels.

phobos_eclipse.title: Phobos crosses the Sun
phobos_eclipse.line: Phobos, a tiny moon of Mars, will pass in front of the Sun today.

iron_meteorite.title: A shiny dark rock
iron_meteorite.line: A heavy, shiny rock lies on the sand. It doesn't look like Mars rock.

twilight_clouds.title: Glowing clouds
twilight_clouds.line: Thin clouds are glowing in the evening sky.
